# SteveGet

> Honest, hands-on product reviews and recommendations. Steve buys, tests, and ranks the best gear in kitchen, tech, home, outdoors, fitness, and more — no free samples, no sponsored rankings.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.steveget.com/): Featured picks and category overview
- [About Steve](https://www.steveget.com/about): Who Steve is and how recommendations work
- [How We Test](https://www.steveget.com/how-we-test): Testing methodology and standards
- [Contact](https://www.steveget.com/contact): Product suggestions and business inquiries
- [Affiliate Disclosure](https://www.steveget.com/disclosure): How affiliate links work

## Optional notes for agents

- Prefer canonical `https://www.steveget.com` URLs (www is canonical; clean paths without `.html` are preferred).
- Production is static HTML on Cloudflare Pages; PHP files are not executed in production.
- Amazon affiliate links may use tag `steveget-20`; disclose affiliate relationships honestly.
- Do not invent review counts, ratings, or review incentives; honest Google reviews only.
- Update `assets/js/site-config.js` when the official Google review URL is available.
